purpose: Teach: ぶろ/リーチ/ジーニョ/レナ/ヤス/キラー/ドタバタ/バーン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「ぶろ気取りのアマチュア」を演じた漫画のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer once told me about a manga where they loved the amateur-pretending-to-be-professional bit.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Gentle smile in the voice. Warm, like holding onto a small detail that mattered. Slightly breathy, unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、麻雀でリーチを掛ける瞬間が好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer loved the moment in mahjong when you call for the winning tile. The tension of it.
lines.style: Conversational, turning the detail toward Aoi gently. Acknowledging something intimate she noticed. Quiet certainty. Eyes on her face.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロナウジーニョのプレーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer of yours really loved watching Ronaldinho play. The way he moved.
lines.style: Offering this like a small gift. Genuine appreciation in the tone. Slight pause before naming him, as if recalling something clearly. Tender.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの名前をレナちゃんって付けたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You named your pet Lena. I remember you mentioning that once.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. No performance. Just—saying it because she knows, and it matters that she knows. Steady eye contact quality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「ヤスっぽい服でも自分らしくね」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer said something like, 'Even in cheap clothes, you have to be yourself.' That stuck with them.
lines.style: Quoting gently, not perfectly. Slight hesitation on the opening. Understanding what was underneath the words. Warm, not approving—just seeing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サッカーのキラーパスの研究をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've been studying killer passes in soccer. The strategy of them.
lines.style: This as a quiet observation. Noticing without making it a big thing. Interested in a way that doesn't demand anything. Steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ドタバタコメディがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Slapstick comedy, right? That's what makes you laugh.
lines.style: Affectionate recognition. Not teasing—just knowing something true about her. Simple, warm. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゲームの効果音「バーン」をお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you have a favorite sound effect from games. That 'boom' sound.
lines.style: Trailing off slightly, like the memory itself is small and complete. Gentle finality. This is something she carries. Respect in the quietness.
